items.item_text: A Bachelor’s degree (*attach transcript); AND
A Master’s degree in education, organizational leadership/behavior, or related field

Two (2) years of professional, coordinator experience in a related field that will demonstrate possession of the knowledge and abilities necessary to meet the performance objectives of the essential duties and responsibilities of this job description; AND
Substitutions for the professional experience requirement are allowed, up to a maximum of one (1) year
Three (3) years of professional experience working with community college students. Knowledge of current issues faced by students who have unmet needs
CalFresh program eligibility requirements and application process

Envi ronment: Work is performed primarily in a standard office setting with travel from site to site. The incumbent must be able to work in a fast paced office environment with background noise and a high stress level.
Community based programs that offer basic needs assistance i.e., food, shelter, clothing, utility assistance
Hearing: Hear in the normal audio range with or without correction.
Educational opportunities available at the community college level, labor and market conditions, socio-economic issues, and their impact on current students Grant and categorical program filing needs
Program and operating procedures, updates, guidelines, rules, policies, and regulations
Applicable Federal, State, and local laws
Record keeping
Reporting
Program resources and client base
Community organizations and agencies
Computer programs
Basic math
Accounting principles
Grant proposal preparation
Accurate data entry
Meeting schedules and timelines
Communicating effectively both orally and in writing
Maintaining documentation and records
Handling multiple assignments simultaneously and set priorities based on customer needs
Provide and coordinate a variety of services and activities to assist students and their families Learn computer programs, and program parameters quickly
Make changes required by program updates
Effectively prioritize workload tasks
Train and provide work direction to others

Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others, including those from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, ethnic, gender identity, sexual orientation, and disability backgrounds of community college students, faculty, and staff

Demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, faculty, and staff

Physical: Primary function requires sufficient physical ability and mobility to work in an office setting and travel from site to site; to stand or sit for prolonged periods of time; to occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach and twist; to lift carry, push, and/or pull light to moderate amounts of weight up to 20 pounds; to operate office equipment requiring repetitive hand movements and fine coordination including use of a computer keyboard; and to verbally communicate to exchange information.
Vision: See in the normal visual range with or without correction; vision sufficient to read computer screens and printed documents; and to operate assigned equipment.
